claim: AIM-OS enables compliance engineering through automated evidence collection, audit trail generation, and regulatory artifact production.
CMC provides bitemporal storage enabling 'what was true at time T?' queries for audit purposes.
VIF provides complete provenance through witness envelopes with model ID, prompts, tools, and confidence levels.
SEG links compliance claims to supporting evidence and enables contradiction detection.
SDF-CVF ensures quartet parity (code/docs/tests/traces) for compliance artifacts.
Authority system enforces role-based access controls for compliance requirements.
CAS provides continuous monitoring and alerting for compliance violations.
Timeline system tracks security incidents and compliance events for audit purposes.
Compliance dashboards surface evidence gaps, aging artifacts, and policy violations automatically.
AIM-OS supports multiple regulatory frameworks simultaneously with unified evidence base.
